correctness.rationale: For all finite nonempty I, Λ and regular binary P, direct Rees multiplication yields B_{(i,λ),(j,μ)}=Z_{λj}Z_{μi}. After an orthogonal rectangular SVD, the self-adjoint map X↦(ZXZ)^T is a signed weighted transpose on an r×r block and zero on its complement. This gives exactly r diagonal eigenvalues s_a², paired ±s_as_b for a<b, and mn-r² zeros. The odd trace sequence reconstructs all s_a²>0 by rational pole uniqueness. Degree and edge counts follow from independent zero-position choices. Standalone checker validates 327 exhaustive regular patterns of dimensions at most 3×3 plus 400 seeded larger patterns; finite tests are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The invariant is motivated by 0-Rees multiplication and its graph-theoretic zero pattern. One exact all-size result compresses an mn-dimensional real annihilation spectrum to singular values of an n×m zero-incidence matrix, yielding the entire rank/inertia, closed-walk sequence and energy, as well as a converse spectral rigidity result. The inertia depends only on real zero-pattern rank, and bipartite cospectrality becomes exactly equivalent to semigroup annihilation cospectrality for fixed dimensions. Such a complete structural invariant is more informative than a single easy count or arbitrary parameter slice, though the reduction uses standard SVD rather than a new linear-algebra lemma.
